factual_errors: Forecast counter-evidence claims the three analogs 'evolve to ROTATION/REJECTION/EXPANSION, none to TREND'. FALSE: analog A12220 evolves ACCEPTANCE(0) -> REJECTION(4) -> TREND(8) -> ROTATION(12) -> ROTATION(16). TREND is reached at step 8, so trend_continuation IS corroborated by one of the three analogs - the exact opposite of the claimed 'no life-cycle corroboration'.

Forecast expected_state_transition claims 'most likely per historical analogs A310/A12220 which evolve from ACCEPTANCE into ROTATION'. Misread: A12220's IMMEDIATE transition (step 4) is to REJECTION, not ROTATION (it reaches ROTATION only at step 12); A23519 holds ACCEPTANCE through step 8. Only A310 (1 of 3) rotates at step 4. 'Most likely ROTATION' is not supported by the analog record.

Forecast states 'Price sits just above a heavily-touched swing low at 4086.785'. Contradicted by its own cited bars: H1 current close 4085.535 is BELOW 4086.785, and H4 current close 4057.715 is 29.07 below the level. The 'above' reading cherry-picks M1/M5/M15 closes while the H1/H4 bars it simultaneously cites as wick evidence closed below the defended level.
insufficient_evidence: Claim 'aggressive rejection of the lows' / 'active buyers near 4072.7 / 4039.7' rests only on wick geometry (quality RAW_GEOMETRY + DERIVED); there is no volume, order-flow, or tape evidence in the context to establish buyer intent.

Claim 'repeatedly defended, high-confluence support' rests on touch_count_240=19 (DERIVED pivot touch count). Touches are price excursions, not successful defenses; no evidence in context that the level has actually HALTED a close below it (break_status INSIDE, reclaim_status NONE, and H1/H4 closes are already below it).
Claim 'bounces capped near 4095.185-4099.315' asserts a cap mechanism with no evidence for why those session highs would cap rotations.

M1/M5 trend_20 (+4.17/+0.57 over 20 bars) is characterized as 'a bounce already in progress' contradicting continuation - a ~4-point 20-minute drift is trivial relative to the ~60-90 point H1/H4 displacement and cannot carry that interpretive weight.
missed_counter_evidence: Cross-timeframe close inconsistency at the identical timestamp 12:00:00: H4 close 4057.715 vs H1 close 4085.535 vs M15 close 4087.535 vs M5 4091.865 vs M1 4092.315. The H1/H4 current-bar lows (4072.755 / 4039.685) do not appear anywhere in the M1/M5/M15 sequence_last_N data for the same period (lowest M15 low in the window is 4085.255). The forecast never notices this, yet builds its primary case on exactly those wicks.

The forecast's own invalidation rule for the primary scenario is already met by its own cited data: H4 close 4057.715 is 29.07 below 4086.785 (far beyond 'roughly one M15 ATR ~7.4') and H1 close 4085.535 is below the level, with H1/H4 range_percentile 0.795/0.81 (ranges expanding) and reclaim_status NONE. The support it defends has already been closed below in the very bars it cites.
Analog A12220 reaches TREND at step 8 - the forecast's claim that no analog corroborates trend_continuation misses this.

L4 mechanism candidate (trend_continuation) invalidation is 'decisive break of the active level'; per the cited H1/H4 closes the decisive break may already have occurred, which would flip the only formal mechanism to 'invalidated', not 'supported'.
mechanism_jumps: Lower wick -> 'aggressive rejection of the lows' / 'active buyers': a wick is a price excursion; attributing buyer intent is a mechanism attribution with no order-flow evidence.
19 touches -> 'repeatedly defended': conflates touch frequency (DERIVED counter) with defense quality.

Fresh ACCEPTANCE label (dwell 1, ambiguity_rate_8 0.625) -> 'the level holds': a single ambiguous labeler print (7 of the last 8 state prints were REJECTION) is treated as confirmation of support defense.

Confidence 0.55 for support-hold assigned despite 0.625 labeler ambiguity, own closes below the level, and no external (macro/news/flow) confirmation of any kind.
'Down-impulse into MAJOR support' upgrades a DERIVED pivot level to 'major' on touch count alone without evidence the level has held a close.
time_window_issues: The 12:00 H1 and H4 bars are treated as completed, observed bars at the forecast instant, but their OHLC (lows 4072.755/4039.685, closes 4085.535/4057.715) is inconsistent with the same-instant M1/M5/M15 bars and their opens equal the M1 12:00 open - consistent with forming bars containing post-cutoff (12:00+) price action. If those bars are complete, the move to those targets already happened; if they are forming/lookahead, the targets are derived from future data. strongest_objection: The primary scenario (support-defense/rotation at 4086.785, p=0.55) is contradicted by the forecast's own cited data. Its invalidation rule - a decisive close below 4086.785 beyond ~1 M15 ATR (~7.4) with ranges expanding - is already satisfied by the bars it quotes: H1 closes at 4085.535 (below the level) and H4 closes at 4057.715 (29.07 below, ~4 M15 ATRs) with H1/H4 ranges expanding and reclaim NONE. The forecast simultaneously uses those same bars' lower wicks as 'aggressive rejection' evidence while ignoring their closes. Moreover the H1/H4 current-bar lows (4072.755/4039.685) never appear in the M1/M5/M15 bars at the same timestamp, indicating those bars are either forming (containing post-12:00 lookahead action) or the dataset is misaligned - so the wick story is built on suspect data. If the closes are real, the support has already failed and the primary scenario is already invalidated; if they are not real, the rejection evidence is contaminated. On top of this, the analog counter-evidence is factually wrong (A12220 reaches TREND at step 8, and A12220's immediate transition is REJECTION, not ROTATION). Either way the central thesis fails.
